reasons.action: The brief asks the car to perform a new behavior — pulling forward out of the dark — which is an explicit requested action, so action is request-governed rather than inherited from any plate.
reasons.medium: The medium decision is no_reference: no supplied reference carries rendering authority and no explicit style/medium was requested, so the medium is governed by the request (unstyled).
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is described for any figure, and the supplied storyboard reference has no wardrobe authority; wardrobe defaults to request-governed with nothing overridden.
reasons.lighting: The request specifies an illuminating condition — the car emerging 'out of the dark' — an instruction about visible light quality and darkness, and the reference has no lighting authority; lighting is therefore request-governed.
reasons.framing: The request contains no camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement — pulling forward is subject motion, not a framing instruction — so the supplied storyboard reference, which is licensed for framing, governs the camera framing.
reasons.palette: No explicit grade, hue or contrast treatment is specified and the reference has no palette authority, so palette remains request-governed by default with no reference-derived recoloring.
